name: Pages of Prayer
summary: An open Quran forms the foundation of a symmetric mosque, joining learning and prayer in one compact mark.
why: The minarets mirror around x=54 and their caps meet their shafts at y=48. The mosque base follows the same V-shaped edge as the open pages, so the Quran supports the building instead of being placed beside it. A central page gap keeps the book readable in monochrome.
risk: The Quran is intentionally simplified; at 24px it reads first as a book-shaped foundation. It associates the app with Quran reading as well as prayer.
sub1: A foundation for reflection and devotion
reasonToChoose: You want prayer and Quran reading united in one symbol.

palette.name: PAGES OF PRAYER / TEAL + PARCHMENT + GOLD
